H6VA08252.name: Tony Sabio
H6VA08252.bio: Former U.S. military service member, Secret Service and CIA employee, and private-sector operations leader.

positions.stance: Proposes an Energy Affordability & American Power Act to power the economy through "affordable, reliable, American-made energy."
Proposes an American Jobs & Opportunity Act to build private-sector jobs centered on manufacturing, innovation, skilled trades, apprenticeships, and emerging technologies.
Proposes a Small Business First Act to restore Main Street opportunity, reduce barriers to success, and empower entrepreneurs to grow and create jobs.
Proposes a Safe Communities & Secure America Act to strengthen public safety, secure the borders, and protect critical infrastructure.
Proposes an American Health Freedom Plan: "Affordable Care. More Choices. Stronger Families. Greater Freedom."

H0VA09055.name: Morgan Griffith
H0VA09055.bio: U.S. Representative for Virginia's 9th District, first elected in 2010; former Virginia House of Delegates member and private-practice attorney.

positions.stance: Says job creation requires getting government out of the way; introduced the EPA Regulatory Relief Act to reduce regulations on hospitals, manufacturers, and other businesses.
Supports an "all of the above" energy approach with coal as a vital part, and funding to reclaim abandoned mine sites in coal communities.
Supports requiring voter ID, clearing deceased people from voter rolls, and requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote.
Working on legislation to force Congress to spend no more than it receives and require a supermajority vote to raise the debt limit.
Working to secure the border and crack down on illegal immigration, while welcoming immigrants "who want to come here legally."

H6VA09136.name: Joy Powers
H6VA09136.bio: Fourth-generation cattle farmer and small business owner who ran her family's farm equipment dealership in Bedford County.

positions.stance: Will protect rural hospitals, expand mental health and addiction treatment, and grow the healthcare workforce so families can get care close to home.
Will bring new industries and small business investment to the Ninth District and rebuild infrastructure like roads and broadband.
Will fight to lower housing, grocery, and energy costs by holding corporations accountable and building affordable homes.
Will support teachers, modernize classrooms, and expand access to higher education and job training programs.

H4VA10279.name: Suhas Subramanyam
H4VA10279.bio: Small business owner and former Virginia state senator and delegate; previously served in the Obama administration and volunteered as an EMT/firefighter.

positions.stance: Will protect federal civil servant and contractor jobs in the district and supports U.S. manufacturing, infrastructure investment, and strengthening the middle class.
Believes everyone should have access to reproductive health care and will always support the right to IVF and "a woman's bodily autonomy."
Supports common-sense gun safety laws while "respecting the Second Amendment" and the rights of responsible gun owners.
Says we face a climate emergency; supports environmental protection and conservation while creating jobs and opportunity for small businesses.
Advocates campaign finance reform and supports preventing Members of Congress from trading individual stocks.

H2VA10273.name: Dave Beckwith
H2VA10273.bio: Retired U.S. Air Force colonel and former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense; also worked at Orbital ATK and SAIC.

positions.stance: Will fight to keep taxes low, cut burdensome regulations, and pursue an all-of-the-above energy strategy to lower costs for families and small businesses.
Says Washington should not spend more than it takes in; will push to eliminate wasteful spending and combat fraud.
A staunch supporter of law enforcement who believes well-resourced agencies make safer communities.
Will defend the constitutional rights of every law-abiding citizen: "The Constitution is not a suggestion."
Supports ending market-distorting subsidies and "a bold reinvestment in nuclear power" to lower costs and create jobs.

H6VA11066.name: James Walkinshaw
H6VA11066.bio: U.S. Representative; former Fairfax County supervisor and longtime chief of staff to Congressman Gerry Connolly.

positions.stance: Wants to roll back tariffs, restore ACA tax credits, lower drug costs, and make data centers pay their fair share of electricity costs.
Supports universal health care via a public option on the ACA marketplaces and lowering the Medicare eligibility age.
Opposes cuts to or privatization of Social Security; would strengthen solvency by having the wealthiest pay their fair share.
Supports passing the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, protecting election workers, and banning partisan gerrymandering nationwide.
Opposes more ICE and CBP funding until reforms are in place; supports a path to citizenship and permanent status for Dreamers.

H6VA11249.name: Arthur Purves
H6VA11249.bio: President of the Fairfax County Taxpayers Alliance for 29 years and a retired computer programmer.

positions.stance: Proposes to "slash federal spending without cutting a program" by reducing demand for government services through better policies.
Says ultra-processed food causes chronic disease, including mental illness, and urges eating "real food" to reduce health spending.
Says "billions spent reducing carbon footprint has no impact on atmospheric CO2" and warming is "not a crisis."
Says "mail-in ballots enable election fraud."
"Vet immigrants before they enter," keeping out drug and sex traffickers and gang members.

H0WA08046.name: Suzan DelBene
H0WA08046.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 1st District since 2012; former Microsoft corporate vice president and technology entrepreneur.

positions.stance: Committed to "creating an economy that works for everyone" as families struggle with rising gas, housing, and child care costs.
Working as DCCC chair to win a House majority to hold the Trump administration accountable.
Supports protecting and building on the ACA and getting to universal coverage with a choice between public and private options.
Supports comprehensive immigration reform and legal guardrails "to prevent ICE from committing violence."
Calls for "meaningful action now to combat climate change" to protect health, wellbeing, and natural resources.

H4WA01282.name: Mary Silva
H4WA01282.bio: Audiologist and healthcare provider for the past 20 years.

positions.stance: Supports reshoring semiconductor and tech operations, reforming the H-1B visa program to favor local talent, and expanding apprenticeships and trade education.
Supports fortifying border security, overhauling security clearance procedures, and a full investigation of foreign intelligence involvement in the 9/11 attacks.
Calls for a real audit of the Pentagon and overhauling the intelligence community to reduce reliance on costly contractors.
Would stop misuse of taxpayer funds, from local program fraud to military contractor payouts, and demand accounting of Wall Street bailout profits.
Supports requiring voter ID and establishing a midweek national voting holiday.

H0WA02080.name: Rick Larsen
H0WA02080.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 2nd District and lead Democrat on the House Transportation & Infrastructure Committee.

positions.stance: Opposes sweeping tariffs and "reckless foreign wars" that raise prices; supports lowering utility bills through clean energy and efficiency.
"I believe health care is a right, and I support universal, affordable coverage"; opposes privatizing Medicare and Social Security.
Will not vote for full-year DHS and ICE funding without oversight, including higher training standards, visible ID, and body cameras.
Supports increasing affordable housing supply, helping first-time homebuyers and renters, and strengthening housing tax incentives.
Supports raising the federal minimum wage to $17 per hour, equal pay, skills training, expanded child care, and stronger organized labor.
Proposes a federal Safe Streets mandate tying grants to local cooperation, designating cartels as terrorist organizations, and ending sanctuary policies.
Would dismantle environmental mandates, streamline energy permits, expand nuclear and hydroelectric capacity, and repeal federal carbon taxes.
Would codify that "sex" in Title IX refers exclusively to biological sex.
Supports a federal ban on irreversible medical procedures for minors, prioritizing parental rights.
Would end chain migration and prioritize nuclear families and a merit-based points system.

H2WA03217.name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
H2WA03217.bio: U.S. Representative and small business owner in the trades who, with her husband, has run an auto repair shop.

positions.stance: Will "do whatever it takes to prevent a national abortion ban" and protect women's freedom to choose.
Supports resources for law enforcement to keep fentanyl and illegal guns off the streets, and more federal funding for officer and firefighter pay.
Working to stop farm and consumer equipment manufacturers from forcing customers to pay the original manufacturer for repairs.
Working to bring down housing costs, increase child care options, and "cut out the middlemen who jack up the cost of healthcare."
Takes no money from special interests and supports banning Representatives from trading individual stocks.

H6WA03275.name: John Braun
H6WA03275.bio: Retired Navy captain, manufacturer and small-business owner, and Washington state legislator.

positions.stance: Supports cutting wasteful spending that feeds inflation, reducing red tape on small manufacturers, and protecting the skilled-trades economy.
Supports a federal Parents Bill of Rights and reining in college tuition costs.
Would shut down open-air drug markets, support local camping bans when shelter is available, and fund detox and mental-health beds.
Would complete high-priority barriers, hire more agents, tighten asylum loopholes, and go after cartel supply chains.
Will secure funding for sea lion removal on the Columbia, hatcheries, culverts, and habitat to boost fish runs.

H6WA04190.name: John Duresky
H6WA04190.bio: Retired U.S. Air Force major with 37 years of military and civilian federal service.

positions.stance: Would remove harmful tariffs on farmers, protect irrigation and water rights, and defend agricultural labor access.
Would protect Hanford cleanup and federal jobs, lower housing and healthcare costs, and raise the federal minimum wage.
Would keep rural hospitals open, restore ACA subsidies, protect Medicare and Medicaid, and move toward universal healthcare access.
Would improve VA healthcare, reduce wait times, improve mental health services, and support veterans' transition to civilian life.
Supports congressional term limits, banning congressional stock trading, overturning Citizens United, and Supreme Court ethics reform.

H6WA04216.name: Amanda McKinney
H6WA04216.bio: Yakima County Commissioner and former banker.

positions.stance: Supports President Trump and the America First agenda: secure borders, strong national defense, energy independence, and free markets.
Will fight for strong border enforcement and an immigration system "that puts American safety and sovereignty first."
Supports protecting Title IX and ensuring women's sports "remain for biological females."
Will fight to roll back burdensome regulations, protect working lands, and ensure farmers have a voice; believes "America should feed itself first."
Will fight to restore law and order, dismantle fentanyl trafficking networks, and give law enforcement the tools they need.

H4WA05234.name: Michael Baumgartner
H4WA05234.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 5th District since January 2025; former Washington state senator and State Department economics officer.

positions.stance: Voted to fund the border wall and more Border Patrol, and passed the Laken Riley Act.
Has made preserving the Lower Snake River Dams a federal priority, "protecting our low-cost, carbon-free power."
Sponsored the DETERRENT Act to end foreign adversarial gifts and influence at colleges and universities.
Helped pass a tax package including a senior deduction and no federal taxes on tips or overtime.
Approved the HALT Fentanyl Act to crack down on deadly trafficking.

H4WA05168.name: Carmela Conroy
H4WA05168.bio: Former Spokane County deputy prosecutor and U.S. Foreign Service officer.

positions.stance: "End the tariff chaos" to cut prices for consumers and businesses.
Restore funding for public education, including support for children with special educational needs.
Pass an inflation-indexed federal minimum wage law with paid time off and paid sick leave.
Hold DHS accountable for border security, defunding border security assets not redirected to ports of entry and the borders.
Defund construction and operation of detention centers "as fast as humanely possible" and restore FEMA funding.

H4WA06117.name: Emily Randall
H4WA06117.bio: U.S. Representative and former Washington state senator.

positions.stance: Supports "a just and fair transition away from fossil fuels" and investment in clean energy jobs and infrastructure.
Believes in an economy that works "from the middle class out," equal pay for equal work, and big business paying its fair share.
Will fight to remove barriers to voting and safeguard the right to vote for all eligible voters; does not take corporate PAC money.
Will work to protect and strengthen the ACA, lower out-of-pocket medication costs, and make mental and reproductive health care affordable.
Will support efforts to make all educational pathways, including college and apprenticeships, affordable and accessible.

H6WA06286.name: Teresa Fox
H6WA06286.bio: Safety professional, emergency manager, and public servant.

positions.stance: "Stop runaway government spending."
"Fund workers, not Washington bureaucrats."
"Proper police staffing for rural communities."
"Fair competition and privacy for all."
"Real solutions for rural healthcare deserts."

H6WA07458.name: Pramila Jayapal
H6WA07458.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 7th District since 2017; former state senator and founder of the immigrant advocacy group OneAmerica.

positions.stance: Lead sponsor of the Medicare for All Act "to guarantee health care as a human right."
Lead sponsor of the College for All Act to establish tuition-free higher education for a majority of families.
Lead sponsor of the PRO Act to expand workers' rights and make it easier to form a union.
Lead sponsor of the Raise the Wage Act to increase the federal minimum wage to $15.
Lead sponsor of the National Domestic Workers Bill of Rights to guarantee basic labor protections for domestic workers.

H4WA08147.name: Nirav Sheth
H4WA08147.bio: Marine veteran, former Lakewood police officer, and small business owner in Pierce County.

positions.stance: Says layers of state taxes are driving up costs; backs balanced budgets "without cutting essential services or raising job-killing taxes."
Advocates securing the borders while recognizing immigrants' role in the workforce, and reforms to streamline legal immigration.
Calls to "reaffirm rule of law and prioritize law-abiding citizens over criminals" and to back good officers.
Would reduce unnecessary regulations, encourage direct investment in small businesses, and streamline bureaucratic processes.
Supports upgrading the energy grid against foreign attacks and maintaining and improving bridges and roads.

H8WA08189.name: Kim Schrier
H8WA08189.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 8th District and a pediatrician for 17 years before Congress.

positions.stance: Wrote a bill to temporarily suspend the federal gas tax; fighting corporate price gouging, housing costs, and tariffs.
Believes "affordable and accessible healthcare should be a right"; fighting Medicaid cuts and supports the Women's Health Protection Act.
Opposes Forest Service cuts and tariffs hurting farmers; supports the Specialty Crop Research Initiative and domestic manufacturing.
Supports banning stock trading by members of Congress and the President, Supreme Court ethics reform, and ending presidential criminal immunity.
Supports funding local police, rein-in measures for ICE and CBP, and background checks and safe storage while protecting responsible gun owners.
Supports congressional term limits, single-issue bills, plain-English spending transparency, and ending congressional stock trading.
Would reform the SBA, create tax incentives for small-business growth, simplify the tax code, and encourage U.S. manufacturing.
Would reduce regulatory barriers to building, provide first-time homebuyer tax relief, and address institutional investors buying starter homes.
Would expand thinning, prescribed burning, and year-round wildfire prevention, and protect hydropower.
Calls for reform that puts patients, families, and local providers back at the center, including real price transparency.

H6WA09025.name: Adam Smith
H6WA09025.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 9th District, first elected in 1996, and top Democrat on the House Armed Services Committee; former state senator and Seattle city prosecutor.

positions.stance: Focused on cutting housing costs by easing construction red tape and forcing corporate landlords to divest single-family homes.
Fighting to protect SNAP benefits, healthcare subsidies, and Washington's vote-by-mail system from the Trump administration.
Supports banning congressional stock trading, making polluters pay for cleanup, and creating a universal healthcare system.
Supports raising the federal minimum wage to $20/hour and expanding unions, technical colleges, and workforce training.
Opposes offshore oil drilling off Washington's coast and cuts to wildfire prevention; supports Puget Sound recovery and salmon restoration.

H4WA09061.name: Doug Basler
H4WA09061.bio: Founder and president of Prologue Digital Inc., an advertising and video production company.

positions.stance: Wants "an economy where hard work leads somewhere" so people can start businesses, buy homes, and learn trades.
Says housing, groceries, taxes, and regulations make life too expensive and wants to "make life affordable again."
Supports compassion for people in crisis "while still holding people accountable for crime" and addiction-fueled disorder.
Says the Climate Commitment Act is driving up energy costs "while doing little to directly improve the environment."

H0WA10034.name: Marilyn Strickland
H0WA10034.bio: U.S. Representative for Washington's 10th District; former two-term Mayor of Tacoma and CEO of the Seattle Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce.

positions.stance: Focused on lowering costs and creating jobs by building more housing, fixing roads and bridges, and training students for careers.
Will stand up to attempts to take away health care, protect Medicare, and make health care more affordable.
Working in Congress "to boost renewable energy" and protect the planet for future generations.
Has led bipartisan legislation to help military families facing food insecurity and access affordable housing.

H6AZ05190.name: Jay Feely
H6AZ05190.bio: Former NFL kicker and CBS NFL analyst; board member at StrongWatch and Klein Tools.

positions.stance: Will protect Arizona's water, stand up for farmers and ranchers, defend Second Amendment rights, and stop federal mandates.
Will fight to finish the wall, support mass deportations of violent offenders, back Border Patrol and ICE, and eradicate fentanyl.
Will fight to slash red tape, expand Trump-era tax cuts, unleash domestic manufacturing, and drive down inflation.
Will fight to protect girls' and women's sports by codifying laws ensuring fair competition based on biological sex.
Will fight to restore upward mobility and bring the cost of living down so Arizonans are not priced out.

H4AZ01194.name: Amish Shah
H4AZ01194.bio: Emergency medicine physician and former member of the Arizona House of Representatives.

positions.stance: Will fight to lower costs by rolling back tariffs, making groceries and essentials affordable, and helping job growth rebound.
Will "always stand up to protect Social Security and Medicare" and reverse Medicaid cuts.
Will work to expand coverage, protect Medicare, and lower prescription drug prices; supports codifying Roe v. Wade.
Will act to reduce gun violence, fully fund police, and stop the flow of fentanyl across the border.
Will do everything in his power to protect Arizona's water supply amid drought.

H2AZ01354.name: Eli Crane
H2AZ01354.bio: Former Navy SEAL with five wartime deployments and small business owner.
